description: Renovate covers ONLY what Dependabot cannot read: the Rust toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml and the cargo-installed CI tools (cargo-deny, cargo-audit) pinned in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) keeps cargo (Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock) and github-actions, so enabledManagers is restricted to the two managers below and Renovate never opens a PR for either of those.
The MSRV (`rust-version` in Cargo.toml) is deliberately not tracked: it is a compatibility promise and stays a manual decision. Requires the Renovate GitHub App enabled on the repo.

customManagers.description: cargo-installed CI tools pinned with `cargo install <tool> --locked --version X` in the workflow

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the toolchain and the CI tools.
No automatic major bumps; a person decides those.
